final_name.description: Head east from Lagras and then north to the spur of land above Copperhead Landing, there are often bullfrogs to catch. [#2]
all_descriptions:
Fast travel to Lagras, and ride past Harriet. Plenty near the junction for the bridge and around the large bend in the road.
Further east, you'll find some next to the railway line where the crocodiles gather as well. [#1]
Head east from Lagras and then north to the spur of land above Copperhead Landing, there are often bullfrogs to catch. [#2]

final_name.description: Just to the west of Rhodes station is one patch on the boundary line and near the fallen tree trunks, then ride due west again, almost to the coastline. On the spur of land that sticks out into the lake, there are a couple of patches in the centre of the woods. [#1]
all_descriptions: Just to the west of Rhodes station is one patch on the boundary line and near the fallen tree trunks, then ride due west again, almost to the coastline. On the spur of land that sticks out into the lake, there are a couple of patches in the centre of the woods. [#1]

Go to Emerald Station, and take the road east across the train tracks. There's a patch in the trees just east of the 'D' in 'EMERALD', then head north east for another patch in another group of trees. [#2]
